subject.name: Saint Joseph of Cupertino, Priest
subject.blurb: An Italian Conventual Franciscan friar who was ordained in 1628 despite struggling with formal studies. His ecstatic levitations during prayer drew crowds and repeated transfers between friaries; he met the scrutiny with humility and obedience.
subject.notification: St. Joseph of Cupertino, pray for us!
